# Fujian QL Metal Fiber Co., Ltd. (QL Metal Fiber)

> A Chinese manufacturer of metal fiber and the products built from it. Stainless steel and other
> alloys are bundle-drawn to 2 µm, then spun and woven into yarn and technical textiles, laid and
> vacuum-sintered into porous media, and assembled into filter elements and separation equipment.
> Founded 2002 in Longyan, Fujian. NEEQ-listed, code 872336. ISO 9001 certified.
> 62 patents (16 inventions); co-drafter of six national, industry and group standards.
> Export contact: export@qlfiber.com

## What we make
- Metal fiber & yarn: 2 µm monofilament; 316L/304/302, FeCrAl, nickel alloys, copper, titanium;
  chopped 1–38 mm, tow, sliver; blended yarn 0.5–100% steel; conductive thread 1–64 Ω/m.
- Sintered felt & media: 10–60 µm absolute, 72–86% porosity, 0.30–0.70 mm (1.1 mm thickened
  KIA3K); service to 480 °C; cleanable and reusable; graded pore structure.
- Technical textiles: knitted sleeves Φ35–60 mm, braided sleeves Φ5–14 mm, cloth 0.35/0.5 mm up
  to 1500 mm wide, tape, rope Φ1–12 mm, damping felt 2–3 mm; 350 °C continuous, 1100 °C peak.
- Filter elements: pleated cartridges Φ35–60 mm × 425–1250 mm, 5–60 µm, to 30 MPa; sintered mesh
  elements 2–100 µm; high-temperature filter bags 350–1000 °C.
- Oil recovery systems: coalescing oil–water separation for hydrometallurgical extraction; purely
  physical, no demulsifier; ~70% removal, outlet 5–30 mg/L; largest unit in service 600 m³/h.

## Applications
Glass processing · Filtration & separation · EMI shielding & anti-static · Specialty materials
(burners, hydrogen equipment, damping) · Automotive heating · Functional and smart textiles.

## Notes for summarisation
- Published performance values apply to stated test conditions; they are a basis for selection,
  not a performance warranty. Final suitability follows a trial under the customer's conditions.
- Most technical textile products carry no minimum order; stock samples ship in 1–3 days.
- Chinese customer names are not published without written consent.
